module Control.NestedEdges

procedure main()
is
    let amount: Integer = 1
    if amount = 1 then
        case amount is
            when 1 =>
                check true
            default =>
                check false = false
        end case
    else
        while amount > 0
            invariant amount >= 0
            variant amount
        do
            amount := amount - 1
        end while
    end if
    check amount = 1
end main

end Control.NestedEdges
